issue_request: FHIR-17834 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request raised against MedicationAdministration in STU3. It asked that MedicationAdministration.statusReason be moved next to MedicationAdministration.status because statusReason supplements status; the recorded resolution agreed and said to do this for all resources.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records commit 0ed9e39800d053da56a2248a35d1d166c61d0e4a on 2018-10-18. That merge brought in PR branch commit 411d00442491496e898459ed0927b317328a2c7d, "GF 17834 - move statusReason", which changed the then-current Pharmacy spreadsheet sources for MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, and MedicationRequest.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Current source no longer uses the old spreadsheet files for this resource; the active StructureDefinition source has MedicationAdministration.status immediately followed by MedicationAdministration.statusReason. A current scan of StructureDefinition XML sources found every statusReason element immediately adjacent to its same-parent status element, so the broader "all resources" aspect is also satisfied in current source. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence record was found that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active source already reflects the requested ordering, and no source edit is needed to preserve implementer understanding.
